editorial.overview: The Check Point Certified Maestro Expert (CCME) exam evaluates technical proficiency in managing large-scale, distributed security environments. Certified by Check Point, this exam covers Multi-Domain Security Management architecture, Virtual System Extension (VSX), advanced policy management, and high availability clustering. It confirms an administrator's ability to deploy and troubleshoot complex, multi-domain security infrastructures using Check Point technologies, ensuring that candidates possess the skills to maintain secure network operations across diverse enterprise-level deployments and configurations.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is intended for experienced security engineers and administrators who manage large-scale Check Point deployments. Candidates should have practical experience with Multi-Domain Server environments, VSX configurations, and high availability clustering, along with the ability to troubleshoot complex security management architectures effectively.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official administration guides for Multi-Domain Security Management, VSX, and ClusterXL. Practice using the command line tools and SmartConsole to manage domains, global policies, and log servers. Focus on understanding synchronization processes, failure recovery procedures, and the specific environment variables required for Multi-Domain Server operations. Use the provided documentation to master the deployment and maintenance of these environments, ensuring you are comfortable with all technical aspects of the exam objectives.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the architecture and components of Multi-Domain Security Management, including the Multi-Domain Server, Domain Management Servers, and the Global Domain, providing a foundation for managing large-scale security infrastructures within the Check Point ecosystem.

This domain focuses on Virtual System Extension (VSX) technology, which allows for the creation of virtualized security systems within a single physical environment, enabling efficient resource allocation and management for complex networks and enterprise security requirements.

This domain addresses advanced policy management techniques, including the use of global policies, layers, and dynamic objects across multiple domains to ensure consistent security enforcement throughout the entire enterprise network architecture and security management deployment.

This domain covers high availability and clustering strategies to ensure redundancy and load sharing for Multi-Domain Servers and Domain Management Servers, which are necessary for maintaining continuous security operations in production environments and enterprise network setups.

This domain focuses on troubleshooting techniques for Multi-Domain environments, including log server management, process monitoring, and database recovery, ensuring that administrators can quickly resolve issues and maintain system integrity during failures in the security management infrastructure.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam consists of 60 multiple choice questions. Manage your time effectively during the 90 minutes allotted. Ensure you are familiar with the SmartConsole interface and common CLI commands before starting the linear format test to maximize your performance.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam contains exactly 60 multiple choice questions. Candidates must complete these within the 90 minutes provided to demonstrate their technical proficiency in the subject matter and earn the certification.

The passing score for this certification exam is 70 percent. Candidates must achieve this threshold to successfully earn their credential and validate their expertise in Check Point technologies and security management.
The total exam duration is 90 minutes. Candidates should plan their time carefully to ensure they can answer all 60 questions within this specific time limit provided for the linear format test.

faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam price is 300 dollars. This fee covers the cost of the certification attempt and must be paid in accordance with the official Check Point certification policies and registration requirements.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification valid?
faq.answer_text: The certification is valid for 3 years. After this period, a renewal is required to maintain your status as a certified expert in the Check Point security ecosystem and demonstrate ongoing proficiency.
